Water.name: Water Sprite
Water.desc: A bubbly aquatic Sprite that restores shields for you and nearby squadmates while you are in water.
Water.howToGet: Starter choice; also found near water or in Sprite Chests
Water.chapter: Chapter 6 Season 1; collection version Chapter 7 Season 3

Earth.name: Earth Sprite
Earth.desc: A mossy, rock-and-tree Sprite that increases the chance of extra rare items from chests.
Earth.howToGet: Starter choice; also found in Sprite Chests
Earth.chapter: Chapter 6 Season 1; collection version Chapter 7 Season 3

Fire.name: Fire Sprite
Fire.desc: A fiery Sprite that creates a damaging burst after you deal enough damage to an enemy.
Fire.howToGet: Starter choice; also found in Sprite Chests

Fishy.name: Fishy Sprite
Fishy.desc: An aquatic Fishstick-themed Sprite that boosts swimming speed and briefly speeds you up when damaged.

Air.name: Air Sprite
Air.desc: A wind Sprite that improves sprint speed and jump height and negates fall damage.
Air.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract
Air.chapter: Chapter 6 Season 1; collection version Chapter 7 Season 3

Ghost.name: Ghost Sprite
Ghost.desc: A spectral utility Sprite that briefly cloaks its owner after reloading.
Ghost.howToGet: Spawns at night; extract to unlock

ZeroPoint.name: Zero Point Sprite
ZeroPoint.desc: A reality-energy Sprite that creates a Shield Bubble Jr. when you use a healing item on yourself.
ZeroPoint.howToGet: Rare Sprite Chest find; extract to unlock

Seven.name: Seven Sprite
Seven.desc: A Seven-themed Sprite that reveals enemy foot trails to your squad.
Seven.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

King.name: King Sprite
King.desc: A crowned Sprite that increases the damage dealt by your Pickaxe.
King.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

Boss.name: Boss Sprite
Boss.desc: A powerful companion that boosts its owner's maximum Health and Shield.
Boss.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

Punk.name: Punk Sprite
Punk.desc: A rebellious Sprite that occasionally grants an unlimited-ammo buff.
Punk.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

Sleepy.name: Dream Sprite
Sleepy.desc: A sleepy Sprite that grants a random item at each level and showers Legendary loot at max level.
Sleepy.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

Drifter.name: Aura Sprite
Drifter.desc: An energetic Sprite that grants a Shock Rock charge after you deal enough damage.
Drifter.howToGet: Found in chests and Supply Drops; extract to unlock

Soccer.name: Striker Sprite
Soccer.desc: A soccer-themed Sprite that triggers Overdrive when you mantle or hurdle.
Soccer.howToGet: Score a goal at the Soccer Pitch, then extract

Duck.name: Duck Sprite
Duck.desc: A duck-shaped Sprite that replenishes shields while its owner Emotes or Jams.
Duck.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

GrimReaper.name: Grim Sprite
GrimReaper.desc: A reaper-themed Sprite that marks players who damage you and reveals them on the map.
GrimReaper.howToGet: Extremely rare Sprite Chest find; extract to unlock

RedDemon.name: Demon Sprite
RedDemon.desc: A red demon Sprite that siphons some Health and Shield when you eliminate an opponent.
RedDemon.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

FossilMeal.name: Batman Sprite
FossilMeal.desc: A Batman-themed Sprite that launches you airborne and lets you deploy the Bat Cape to glide.
FossilMeal.howToGet: Find in Sprite Chests, then extract

BurntPeanut.name: Burnt Peanut Sprite
BurntPeanut.desc: An unusual goopy Sprite with a chance to drop extra loot, sometimes Mythic, after eliminations.
BurntPeanut.howToGet: Rare Sprite Chest find; extract to unlock

CokeParmesan.name: Vini Jr. Sprite
CokeParmesan.desc: A Vini Jr.-themed Sprite whose sprint powers a destructive slide; slide-kicks boost fire rate and reload speed.

CompanyStargazer.name: Pollo Sprite
CompanyStargazer.desc: A Pollo-themed Sprite that slowly restores Shield to you and nearby squadmates after an elimination.
